milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a 'find/locate' task — the player must navigate toward and visually identify the oak fence gate on the west wall of the pen. The gate is at spawn-relative [5, 0, 8]. max_distance=16 allows the player to 'find' it from a reasonable viewing distance, and facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is actually looking toward the gate (not just nearby facing away).

Uses inventory_has for beef (min_count=1) because hunting/killing a cow always results in 1-3 raw beef dropping. Since beef is not in the player's starting inventory, any beef present confirms a cow was successfully hunted. This is preferred over count_in_box_at_most because two cows were spawned (so max_count would need to be 1, not 0) and inventory_has directly confirms the kill via guaranteed drops.
